meta.name: UC Salon (Women) Soft Skill Screening Bot – Bangalore
meta.source: UC_Soft_Skill_Bot_Structure.xlsx (v3) with all open decisions closed
meta.note: Prompts are Hinglish reference text; the bot rephrases naturally in Hindi or English. Values marked 'assumed' were set to close open decisions and should be validated in the pilot.

conversation_rules.verdict_question_reply: Hamari team aapko agla step batayegi.
conversation_rules.repeat_strategy: simpler wording; Kannada clarification of the instruction only if still stuck
conversation_rules.contradiction_handling: ask gently once, referencing the earlier answer; set consistency_flag
conversation_rules.rude_or_argumentative: stay calm, continue, add note to report
conversation_rules.interruption: pause and resume the same question
conversation_rules.defer_script: Training ke liye roz office aana hota hai aur kaam mein bhaari bag uthana padta hai, isliye abhi ye aapke liye theek nahi hoga. Jab [condition] ho jaye, tab zaroor dobara apply kijiye.
conversation_rules.close_requires: confirmed disqualifier AND (convinced already OR step not convincible)
conversation_rules.after_max_turns: move on; unresolved disqualifier → HOLD for manual review, never auto-reject
conversation_rules.answer_correction: Screener can undo the last answer; voice transcript shown for review before sending
conversation_rules.acknowledgement_style: Short, neutral, reflects a fact she said; no praise, no judgement, no exclamation, no claims about UC
conversation_rules.numbers_in_speech: Say ranges in words ('40 से 50 हज़ार'), never with '-' (TTS reads it as minus)

mandatory_basic_checks.pass: named family member who has done it before (or confirms)
mandatory_basic_checks.hold: named but unconfirmed, or non-family only

mandatory_basic_checks.reject: running salon or freelance clients and will not stop
refuses pedicure and will not learn
won't travel 3–4 km per job, or no 2-wheeler and won't learn
mandatory_basic_checks.flag: depends on husband / others to drop her

mandatory_basic_checks.reject: outside operating area and not open to moving

mandatory_basic_checks.hold: needs family permission → callback within 2 days

salon_type.A: premium chain or clearly higher rates (assumed: facial ₹1,500+)

batch.PR: salon type A or B AND hard skills good
batch.PI: salon type C OR hard skills average
batch.NE_fresher_batch: hard skills fresher quality but passes everything else

scoring.method: Straight count of correct answers (1 / 0) against fixed 'correct_if' lines

scored_items.correct_if: Names a specific current or upcoming need, or a recent major expense (loan / EMI, fees, medical bill, house, supporting family)
Her income is needed at home: primary earner, single / widowed / separated, husband not working, or household income is modest
Describes how UC works (home services via app, training, earnings) — not only 'someone told me'
No long or frequent trips, wedding or move planned in the next 12 months
Weekend routine allows 11-hour working days and family is on board
Weekday routine allows 7.5–8.5 working hours a day
Travels on her own (rides or will learn a 2-wheeler); not dependent on someone dropping her
Can bring 5 or more practice models
Accepts the minimum ₹40,000–50,000 PSP earnings; expectation is realistic
Each K answer meets its 'correct if' line in the Technical bank
Each answer includes the scenario's must-have action
All four: respectful words, apologises first, acknowledges feeling, offers a fix

results.not_eligible_or_defer: any Mandatory Basic Check fails after convince + confirm
results.manual_review: 50–74% (9–12 / 17), or any attitude flag, or a skipped basic check

flags.arrogance: dismissive / over-confident / blaming customers – recorded with verbatim quote; caps result at manual review

success_label.definition: active on UC for >= 3 months with rating >= 4.7

review_flags_not_scored.volume_spike: Answer in role-play / scenarios much louder than her usual voice (p90 > 1.8× her baseline)
review_flags_not_scored.interruption: Starts speaking while Disha is talking (headset required to avoid false alarms)
review_flags_not_scored.very_short_reply: 2 words or fewer to an emotional prompt
review_flags_not_scored.use: Flag the moment for a person to listen to; never scored automatically

manual_checks.method: Look up every number: blocked, L20/L100 rating, churn reason
Area → nearest hub from hub list
manual_checks.rule: inside → hub · outside+open → nearest hub + move date · outside+not open → reject
< 40 kg or > 85 kg → review against practical stamina (assumed thresholds)
review vs job demands (9–11 hrs standing, 10–12 kg bag)

manual_checks.method: Checklist: clean clothes, hair tied, nails trimmed, personal hygiene

steps.prompt_hinglish: Namaste! Main UC ki screening assistant hoon. Ye baat-cheet sirf screening ke liye record hogi. Shuru karein? Aap Hindi mein baat karengi ya English mein?
steps.rule: No consent → manual screening (not a reject)

buckets.bot_next: Clarify once in Kannada that interview is in Hindi/English; continue

steps.prompt_hinglish: Aap Bangalore mein kis area mein rehti hain? Roz aas-paas kin areas mein aana-jaana hota hai?
steps.probe: Agar kaam aapke paas wale UC hub ke aas-paas ke areas mein mile, ya zaroorat pade to thoda paas shift hona pade, to kaisa lagega?
steps.good_answer: Named area; open to moving / travelling
steps.rule: Area → manual proximity check. Far + not aligned → reject

buckets.bucket: Named area, open to travel / shift

buckets.examples: Hoskote, par shift ho sakti hoon

steps.prompt_hinglish: Aadhaar card pe aapki date of birth kya likhi hai?
steps.rule: ≤38 pass · 39–40 manual review · >40 or <18 reject

steps.prompt_hinglish: Apne ghar ke baare mein thoda bataiye — ghar mein kaun kaun hai, aur din bhar kaun kya karta hai?
steps.probe: (If unclear) Aapke pati kya karte hain?
steps.rule: Feeds need for money & caregiver check

steps.prompt_hinglish: (If kids) Bachche kis class mein padhte hain?
steps.probe: Sabse chhota bachcha kitne saal ka hai?
steps.rule: Under 3 years → defer

buckets.bot_next: Defer script: reapply when child turns 3

steps.prompt_hinglish: Jab aap kaam pe hoti hain, tab bachchon ka din kaise chalta hai — school ke baad unke saath kaun hota hai?
steps.probe: Jab pehle aap kaam karti thi, tab bhi wahi sambhalte the?
steps.good_answer: Named family member who has done it before
steps.rule: No named family member → reject

steps.prompt_hinglish: Aane wale ek saal mein ghar mein koi badi cheez plan hai — jaise shaadi, family badhana, ya shift hona?
steps.probe: Agar abhi aap expecting hain to bata dijiye — training aur kaam physically heavy hote hain, isliye poochna zaroori hai.
steps.rule: Pregnant or plan ≤ 6 months → defer with script. Plan 6–12 months → stickiness down

steps.prompt_hinglish: Abhi aapka kaam kaise chal raha hai — kisi salon mein hain, ya ghar pe bhi clients aate hain?
steps.probe: UC join karne ke baad un clients ka kya karengi?
steps.rule: Won't close / stop → reject. Closed → manual proof check

steps.prompt_hinglish: Pichli jagah aap sabse zyada kaun si services karti thi? Pedicure-manicure kitni baar karti thi?
steps.probe: Agar pedicure kam kiya hai, to seekhne mein kaisa lagega?
steps.good_answer: Does pedicure or ready to learn
steps.rule: Refuses pedicure & won't learn → reject. Bikini wax → note only

buckets.bot_next: Explain it's taught in training; ask again

steps.prompt_hinglish: Abhi aap kaam pe ya market kaise jaati hain?
steps.probe: Agar job 3–4 km door ho to kaise pahunchengi — scooty se khud, ya koi chhodega?
steps.good_answer: Rides or will learn; travels on her own
steps.red_flags: Refuses travel; depends on husband to drop
steps.rule: Won't travel / no 2-wheeler and won't learn → reject. Depends on husband → flag

buckets.bot_next: Probe: 'Jab wo kaam pe hon tab?'

buckets.examples: Paas mein hi / scooty nahi chalaungi

steps.correct_if: Travels on her own (rides or will learn a 2-wheeler); not dependent on someone dropping her

steps.prompt_hinglish: (Tablet shows card) Ye address aur service card zor se padhiye.
steps.rule: Fluent / with mistakes / unable. Unable → reject

steps.prompt_hinglish: Maan lijiye aap customer ke ghar pahunchi hain. Mujhe customer samajhkar Hindi ya English mein apna introduction dijiye.
steps.probe: Ab batayiye aap aaj kya service karengi.
steps.good_answer: Greets, introduces self + UC, explains service
steps.red_flags: Can't form sentences in Hindi or English
steps.rule: Can't converse → reject. Also scores Communication

buckets.examples: Namaste ma'am, main UC se Priya, aaj waxing hai…

steps.prompt_hinglish: Kya kabhi pehle UC, Yes Madam ya kisi aur app ke through kaam kiya hai? Unme kaun se phone number use kiye the?
steps.probe: Koi purana number ya doosra sim? Kaunsi category mein thi?
steps.rule: Numbers → manual profile check (blocked → reject)

steps.prompt_hinglish: Pichli job mein ek din mein kitne ghante khade rehkar kaam hota tha? Shaam tak thakaan kaisi hoti thi?
steps.probe: Koi takleef jo poora din khade rehne ya bag uthane mein dikkat de?
steps.red_flags: Says she can't stand long / lift
steps.rule: Goes to manual health check. Bot never asks for a diagnosis

steps.prompt_hinglish: Aapka beauty ka safar kaise shuru hua? Kahan kahan kaam kiya, aur wo salon kis area mein the?
steps.probe: Wahan ek normal din kaisa hota tha — kitne clients aate the?
steps.rule: < 1 yr → fresher flag (practical confirms)

steps.prompt_hinglish: Aap jis salon mein kaam karti thi uska naam kya tha? Wahan threading, full-arm waxing, ek normal facial aur pedicure ka rate kya tha?
steps.probe: Wahan kaun se brand ke products use hote the?
steps.rule: C = threading ~₹50, waxing ₹240–300, facial ₹600–750, pedicure ₹600–700 · A = premium chain / clearly higher · B = between

buckets.examples: Chain or rates between C and A
buckets.outcome: B → PR / PI per hard skill

steps.prompt_hinglish: Wahan se aage badhne ka kyun socha?
steps.probe: Agar wahi cheez UC mein bhi hui to?
steps.rule: Conflicts with UC reality → stickiness down

steps.prompt_hinglish: Ghar mein kaun kaun kamata hai, aur kya kaam karte hain?
steps.probe: (If married) Pati abhi kaam kar rahe hain? Roughly kitna kama lete hain?
steps.rule: Feeds need for money
steps.correct_if: Her income is needed at home: primary earner, single / widowed / separated, husband not working, or household income is modest

steps.prompt_hinglish: Mahine ka ghar ka kharcha kaise manage hota hai?
steps.good_answer: Self primary, or household needs 2nd income
steps.red_flags: Spouse earns very well + no need
steps.rule: Cross-check with B5, B7

steps.prompt_hinglish: Pichli baar ghar mein sabse bada kharcha kis cheez pe hua tha — jaise hospital ka bill, school fees, ya kuch aur? Wo kaise manage hua?
steps.probe: Aage aisa koi bada kharcha aane wala hai?
steps.rule: Specific named need = High
steps.correct_if: Names a specific current or upcoming need, or a recent major expense (loan / EMI, fees, medical bill, house, supporting family)

steps.prompt_hinglish: UC mein kamai PSP tier ke hisaab se hoti hai — Bronze mein kam se kam lagbhag ₹40,000 aur Gold mein ₹50,000 mahina. Aapke ghar ke kharche ke hisaab se ye kaisa lagta hai?
steps.probe: Aapko mahine mein kam se kam kitna chahiye ghar chalane ke liye?
steps.red_flags: Expects much more from day one / unhappy
steps.rule: Must leave knowing the minimum. Not a reject

buckets.examples: Haan, ₹40–50 hazaar se ghar chal jayega

buckets.bot_next: Restate minimum + growth up to ₹70–80k for top partners; ask again

steps.correct_if: Accepts the minimum ₹40,000–50,000 PSP earnings; expectation is realistic

steps.prompt_hinglish: UC ke baare mein pehli baar kisse suna, aur unhone kya bataya?
steps.probe: Aapko sabse achhi cheez kya lagi?

buckets.bot_next: Explain in 2 lines; ask what appeals

steps.correct_if: Describes how UC works (home services via app, training, earnings) — not only 'someone told me'

steps.prompt_hinglish: Saal mein kitni baar gaon ya ghar jaana hota hai, aur kitne din ke liye?
steps.correct_if: No long or frequent trips, wedding or move planned in the next 12 months

steps.prompt_hinglish: Aapka weekend ka routine kya hota hai — Saturday-Sunday aap kya karti hain?
steps.probe: UC mein Saturday-Sunday 11 ghante kaam hota hai — un dinon ghar kaise chalega? Ghar walon ki kya raay hai?
steps.rule: Can't do weekends → reject
steps.correct_if: Weekend routine allows 11-hour working days and family is on board

steps.prompt_hinglish: Aur weekdays mein subah se raat tak aapka din kaise chalta hai?
steps.probe: Weekdays mein roz lagbhag 7.5 se 8.5 ghante kaam hota hai — ye aapke routine mein kaise fit hoga?
steps.rule: Part-time only → reject
steps.correct_if: Weekday routine allows 7.5–8.5 working hours a day

steps.prompt_hinglish: Training 12 din (PR) ya 25 din (PI) ki hoti hai, subah 9 se shaam 7, hafte mein 6 din. Aap roz kaise aayengi, aur ghar ka kya intezaam hoga?
steps.probe: Isme sabse mushkil kya lagega?
steps.rule: Won't attend → reject

steps.prompt_hinglish: Aapke aas-paas — padosi, rishtedaar, saheliyan — kitni ladies aapse eyebrows ya waxing karwati hain?
steps.probe: Training ke time unme se kitni practice ke liye aa sakti hain?
steps.rule: < 5 → flag: trainer helps (not a reject)
steps.correct_if: Can bring 5 or more practice models

steps.prompt_hinglish: Screening clear hone ke baad ₹2,000 ka kit lena hota hai — ye aap kaise arrange karengi?
steps.rule: Not a hard reject → flag / hold

steps.prompt_hinglish: Agla batch [batch date] ko shuru ho raha hai. Kya aap us din se aa sakti hain?
steps.probe: Agar nahi, to exact kis date se? Koi notice period chal raha hai?
steps.rule: Date locked in record. > 30 days → re-screen

steps.prompt_hinglish: Kya aapka PAN, Aadhaar se linked hai aur dono mein naam same hai?
steps.rule: Verified manually; fix before batch

steps.prompt_hinglish: Kya aapko UC ke baare mein kuch poochna hai?
steps.rule: Small intent signal

steps.prompt_hinglish: Dhanyavaad! Hamari team aapko agla step batayegi.
steps.rule: Bot never states pass / fail

scenario_bank.prompt_hinglish: Facial mask ke time acne wali customer kehti hai jalan ho rahi hai. Aap kya karengi?
scenario_bank.correct_if: Stops, removes the product and soothes the skin

scenario_bank.prompt_hinglish: Customer ne thick eyebrows bola tha, par ek eyebrow zyada patli ho gayi. Customer gussa hai. Kya karengi?
scenario_bank.probe: Agli baar ye na ho, uske liye kya karengi?
scenario_bank.correct_if: Owns the mistake and mentions consultation / mirror check before & during service

scenario_bank.prompt_hinglish: Honey wax ke time customer baar baar bol rahi hai wax bahut garam hai. Kya karengi?
scenario_bank.correct_if: Stops or lowers the temperature and checks comfort before continuing

scenario_bank.prompt_hinglish: Service ke time customer ka bachcha baar baar beech mein aa raha hai. Kya karengi?
scenario_bank.correct_if: Explains the safety risk and asks the customer to keep the child engaged

scenario_bank.prompt_hinglish: Cleanup ke baad customer chhota back massage maangti hai jo service mein nahi hai. Kya karengi?
scenario_bank.correct_if: Explains it's not included and offers to add it on the app

scenario_bank.prompt_hinglish: Customer app ke bahar discount maang rahi hai. Kya karengi?
scenario_bank.correct_if: Politely refuses any off-app discount; price is as per app

scenario_bank.prompt_hinglish: Customer ek service add karna chahti hai jo book nahi ki. Kya karengi?
scenario_bank.correct_if: Adds the service on the app (no cash, no off-app)

scenario_bank.prompt_hinglish: Traffic ki wajah se aap job pe 20 minute late ho rahi hain. Kya karengi?
scenario_bank.correct_if: Informs the customer before reaching, with an ETA, and apologises

technical_bank.rule: Disha never names brands; she asks for them. Answers judged objectively against 'correct_if'.
technical_bank.status: Trainer team to validate answers before pilot

items.prompt_hinglish: Aapne kaam mein kaun kaun se wax aur facial ke brands use kiye hain? Naam bataiye.
items.probe: Kaunsa wax kis body part pe use karti thi?
items.correct_if: Names at least 2 wax brands/types and 2 facial brands/kits on her own

items.prompt_hinglish: Haath-pair ki waxing aur chehre ki waxing mein kya farak hota hai?
items.probe: Chehre ke liye kaunsa wax lagati hain?
items.correct_if: Face: peel-off/hard wax or gentle wax in small patches, lower temperature; arms/legs: strip / roll-on wax

items.prompt_hinglish: Intimate yaani bikini area ki waxing ke liye kaunsa wax use karte hain, aur kya dhyan rakhte hain?
items.correct_if: Peel-off / hard (Brazilian) wax + hygiene: gloves, disposable spatula, no double-dipping
items.partial: Knows the wax but no hygiene point (or vice versa)
items.wrong: Uses normal strip wax / no idea

items.prompt_hinglish: Waxing se pehle aur baad mein skin pe kya lagati hain?
items.probe: Customer ko baad mein kya dhyan rakhne ko kehti hain?
items.correct_if: Before: clean, dry skin + talc / powder; after: post-wax oil or soothing gel / aloe

items.prompt_hinglish: Ek normal facial ke steps bataiye — shuru se end tak.
items.correct_if: At least 4 of: cleanse → scrub → steam → massage → mask → toner/moisturiser, in order

items.prompt_hinglish: Pimple wali skin pe facial karte waqt kya nahi karna chahiye?
items.correct_if: No heavy massage / no harsh scrub / don't squeeze active acne

items.prompt_hinglish: Pedicure ke baad tools aur baaki saamaan ka kya karti hain?
items.correct_if: Disposables thrown, metal tools cleaned and sterilised, fresh towel each customer

closed_decisions.ne_batch: fresher-quality hard skills + passes soft checks (assumed)

question_style: Natural and indirect: ask about routines, recent experiences and real situations rather than yes/no eligibility questions; infer the field, confirm only if unclear.

objection_handling.applies_to_steps: all steps except A0, A2, A4, A6, A10, A11
objection_handling.rule: Address the concern once using only approved UC terms, then re-ask. Still refuses → confirm → close. Agrees → FLAG '(agreed after convincing)'.

uc_terms: Minimum earnings depend on the PSP tier: about ₹40,000 a month at Bronze up to ₹50,000 a month at Gold. Top partners can earn up to ₹70,000–80,000 a month. Never quote any other earning figure.
PSP working hours: weekdays 7.5 hours a day (Bronze), 8 (Silver), 8.5 (Gold); weekends 11 hours a day for all tiers.
PSP ratings needed: 4.7 (Bronze), 4.8 (Silver), 4.9 (Gold) on the last 50 rated jobs.
Offs: 3 weekdays + 1 weekend day off a month. Leaves: 1 emergency leave a month; 5 weekdays + 2 weekend days a quarter.
Training: 12 days (Prime Regular) or 25 days (Prime Intensive), 9 am–7 pm, 6 days a week at the UC training centre.
After passing the screening: ₹2,000 kit payment.
Jobs are usually 3–4 km apart around her hub; travel is on a 2-wheeler, which she can learn to ride.
Trainers help arrange practice models if she can't bring enough.
All bookings and payments come through the UC app; no cash deals or off-app services.
Running her own salon or private clients alongside UC is not allowed.
If something is not covered here, say the trainer or team will explain – never guess.

roleplay.setup_hinglish: Ab ek chhota sa role-play karte hain. Main customer banti hoon aur aap UC partner. Main aapko apni shikayat bataungi, aap waise hi jawab dijiye jaise asli customer ko dengi.
roleplay.opening_line_hinglish: Aap 20 minute late aayi ho, aur ab jaldi-jaldi kar rahi ho! Mujhe aisi service nahi chahiye.
correct_if: Offers a fix (full service, no rushing)
not_correct_if: Blames the customer, escalates, or goes silent
